display.purpose: Archivo Black uppercase headlines, labels, and wordmark.

body.purpose: Space Grotesk for all reading, writing, and controls.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Initial hero entrance; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow, sharp, uppercase control with a 2px black border and hard shadow.
components.css: .neo-button { background:#fff; color:#000; border:2px solid #000; border-radius:0; box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #000; padding:12px 24px; font-family:'Archivo Black',Impact,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .neo-button:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #000; outline-offset:2px; } .neo-button:disabled { background:#f5f0e6; color:#000; opacity:1; box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000; } .neo-button--primary { background:#ffeb3b; }

components.name: Editor Card
components.description: White centerpiece with a 3px black border and 6px hard shadow.
components.css: .neo-card { background:#fff; border:3px solid #000; border-radius:0; box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #000; padding:24px; }

components.name: Meaning Panel
components.description: Blue result panel shown last in the result stack.

narrative.overview: An approachable neobrutalist learning tool with flat color, heavy black structure, hard shadows, and direct teaching language.
keyCharacteristics: Flat opaque color with no gradients or blur.
Black 2–3px borders and zero-blur hard shadows.
Archivo Black display type with Space Grotesk body type.
The editor remains the largest and most important object.
Corrections stay explanatory rather than punitive.

rules.name: Show the Structure
rules.body: Every surface has one job, one flat fill, and a visible black boundary.

rules.name: Loud, Not Confusing
rules.body: Bold presentation strengthens hierarchy and never competes with readability.

rules.name: Physical Controls
rules.body: Interactive elements respond with position and hard-shadow changes.

dos: Use flat colors, thick black borders, and hard shadows.
Keep focus states and text contrast unmistakable.
Use uppercase display type only for short headings and labels.
donts: Do not use gradients, transparency, blur, soft shadows, or rounded cards.
Do not use muted low-contrast text.
Do not turn proofreading into grades or scores.
